source.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
source.excerpt: Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.

cards.headline: Deep learning applications in cancer treatment Prediction

source.title: Deep learning applications in cancer treatment Prediction: Comprehensive research foundation for systematic review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: Outcome measures included treatment response prediction (measured via AUC), overall survival and progression-free survival (evaluated using C-index and hazard ratios), and clinical utility (assessed through net benefit and decision curve analyses).

cards.headline: AI applications in veterinary digital health: a systematic survey

source.title: AI applications in veterinary digital health: a systematic survey.
source.excerpt: Overall, the findings emphasize the importance of standardized datasets, robust model validation, explainable AI (XAI), and interdisciplinary collaboration to ensure the safe, reliable, and ethical integration of AI into veterinary medicine.

source.title: Geschichte von Tarent
source.excerpt: Die Geschichte von Tarent, der Stadt im süditalienischen Apulien, beginnt legendenhaft fassbar im späten 8. Jahrhundert v. Chr. mit der Gründung der Apoikie Taras durch Sparta, doch die älteste Quelle stammt erst aus dem Jahr 473 v. Chr. Wie inzwischen archäologisch belegt ist, wurde das heutige Tarent spätestens in der Jungsteinzeit erstmals besiedelt.

cards.headline: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation

source.title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
source.excerpt: Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing GR baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence for medical imaging education: bibliometric and visual analysis

source.title: Artificial intelligence for medical imaging education: bibliometric and visual analysis.
source.excerpt: This study characterizes a dual-polar production structure with the United States and China as dominant contributors, and a journal distribution spanning medical education and imaging technology venues. The post-2022 emergence of generative AI keywords documented a new thematic cluster alongside foundational machine learning research, indicating an evolving methodological repertoire.

cards.headline: Use of artificial intelligence in education and training of radiology

source.title: Use of artificial intelligence in education and training of radiology.
source.excerpt: AI has significant potential to strengthen radiology education through personalized learning, competency development, and technology-enhanced training. Nevertheless, sustainable implementation requires standardized curricula, faculty development, competency frameworks, and robust ethical oversight.

source.title: Volkskammer
source.excerpt: Die Volkskammer war vom 7. Oktober 1949 bis zum 2. Oktober 1990 das Parlament der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik (DDR). Nominell war sie das höchste Verfassungsorgan, tatsächlich bestimmte aber die Sozialistische Einheitspartei Deutschlands (SED) die Politik der DDR. Dies änderte sich erst durch die Friedliche Revolution von 1989/90.

cards.headline: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information

source.title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
source.excerpt: Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.

cards.headline: Vitreoretinal disease detection using artificial intelligence

source.title: Vitreoretinal disease detection using artificial intelligence: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: AI diagnostic tools, particularly CNNs, have demonstrated robust performance in VRDs detection. However, results from studies with limited generalizability should be applied cautiously in real-world settings. Further exploration of emerging models, such as large language models (LLMs), is recommended.

cards.headline: Machine learning models of segmentation in acute ischemic stroke

source.title: Machine learning models of segmentation in acute ischemic stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: ML-based segmentation models for AIS demonstrate high accuracy, especially when using multimodal MRI and deep learning architectures. Performance is robust across varying dataset sizes and lesion characteristics. However, heterogeneity in study designs and reporting standards underscores the need for methodological harmonization and external validation.

source.title: Lunar Orbiter 1
source.excerpt: Lunar Orbiter 1 war die erste von fünf Mondsonden des Lunar-Orbiter-Programms der US-amerikanischen Weltraumorganisation NASA. Mit dem Lunar-Orbiter-Programm sollte der Mond in hoher Auflösung fotografisch erfasst und kartografiert werden, um so Landeplätze für die Raumsonden des Surveyor-Programms sowie für die bemannte Mondlandung zu finden.

cards.headline: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents

source.title: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
source.excerpt: We publicly release Gym-Anything-RT and the generated minigames to spur further research on AI agents in real-time interactive settings.

cards.headline: AI Models for Predicting Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) and Post-AKI Mortality

source.title: AI Models for Predicting Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) and Post-AKI Mortality: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: ML models have shown high average discrimination for AKI occurrence and post-AKI mortality, supporting their potential value for AKI risk stratification and early warning. However, high levels of heterogeneity, limited external or prospective validation, and inconsistent reporting of model calibration and clinical utility mean that substantial barriers remain before routine clinical deployment.

cards.headline: Für jene gibt es einen Anteil an dem, was sie verdient haben.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:202
source.excerpt: أولئك الداعون بهذا الدعاء لهم ثواب عظيم بسبب ما كسبوه من الأعمال الصالحة. والله سريع الحساب، مُحْصٍ أعمال عباده، ومجازيهم بها.

cards.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
cards.translation: Für jene gibt es einen Anteil an dem, was sie verdient haben. Und Allah ist schnell im Abrechnen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Order for Remembrance of Allah and seeking Good in this Life and the Hereafter upon completing the Rites of Hajj: Allah commands that He be remembered after the rituals are performed.

cards.headline: Und gedenkt Allahs während einer bestimmten Anzahl von Tagen.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:203
source.excerpt: واذكروا الله تسبيحًا وتكبيرًا في أيام قلائل، وهي أيام التشريق: الحادي عشر والثاني عشر والثالث عشر من شهر ذي الحجة. فمن أراد التعجل وخرج من «مِنى» قبل غروب شمس اليوم الثاني عشر بعد رمي الجمار فلا ذنب عليه، ومن تأخر بأن بات بـ «مِنى» حتى يرمي الجمار في اليوم الثالث عشر فلا ذنب عليه، لمن اتقى الله في حجه. والتأخر أفضل; لأنه تزوُّد في العبادة واقتداء بفعل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.

cards.arabic: ۞ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۚ فَمَن تَعَجَّلَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَن تَأَخَّرَ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ لِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
cards.translation: Und gedenkt Allahs während einer bestimmten Anzahl von Tagen. Wer sich jedoch in zwei Tagen (mit dem Aufbruch) beeilt, den trifft keine Sünde, und wer länger bleibt, den trifft keine Sünde; (das gilt) für den, der gottesfürchtig ist. Fürchtet Allah und wißt, daß ihr zu Ihm versammelt werdet!
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
